sql: with picks as (select k, n from jsonb_array_elements_text(:picks::jsonb) with ordinality as e(k, n)), unknown as (select k, n from picks where not exists (select 1 from brandbase.moodboard_posts p where p.id = picks.k and p.brand_id = :brand) and not exists (select 1 from brandbase.pasted_links x where x.id = picks.k and x.brand_id = :brand)) select not exists (select 1 from unknown) as ok, (select jsonb_agg(k order by n) from unknown) as details
message: a pick is not on this brand's moodboard
